nodes.title: 提示词
widgets_values:
subject_definitions
<Subject 1>: The adult heroine shown throughout <Picture 1>. Preserve her identity, hairstyle, clothing, and accessories. The other people are the adult male attackers from the same reference.

summary
[reference generation] A 15-second, 16:9 photorealistic martial-arts sequence in the referenced underground mahjong den. ONE CONTINUOUS UNBROKEN CAMERA TAKE, from the opening confrontation to the final facial close-up. All fighting plays at fast, natural real-time speed. Absolutely no slow motion.

retention_analysis
<Picture 1>: fully_preserved for heroine identity and wardrobe; partially_preserved for attackers, room layout, props, and action beats; attribute_transfer for lighting, palette, smoke, and photographic texture. Treat the nine panels as sequential action references within ONE continuous space and take, not as separate edited shots. Do not reproduce the grid or borders.

detailed_description
Gritty 1990s Hong Kong/Korean crime-thriller realism: desaturated teal and brown, cold blue-gray smoke, deep shadows, subtle film grain, overhead fluorescent tubes and warm amber practical lamps. Preserve the reference's green felt mahjong tables, white tiles, green bottles, wood-paneled walls, brown leather sofa, and CRT static television.

[Shot 1] ONE UNINTERRUPTED 15-SECOND HANDHELD TAKE. Begin at medium-close distance over <Subject 1>'s shoulder. A stocky bearded attacker reaches toward her chin. During seconds zero to two, she catches his wrist, pivots, and delivers a compact palm strike to his upper chest. He staggers backward onto the nearby mahjong table, scattering tiles. The camera takes a short lateral step to show the impact while keeping her visible.

During seconds two to four, a second man swings a wooden chair from her side. She ducks and the chair strikes the wall behind her, splintering. The camera makes a short, sharp whip-pan that follows her duck and rise, physically traveling with the action; motion blur is brief and never hides a cut.

During seconds four to six, she lowers her weight and sweeps another approaching man's supporting leg. He falls against the edge of the same table. The operator briefly lowers the camera to show her planted support and his loss of balance, then rises again. Keep the room geography continuous.

During seconds six to eight, a bottle-wielding man advances from beside the sofa. She sidesteps, catches his wrist, and forces the bottle against a hard table corner. Glass and liquid burst from the contact point. The operator steps closer in a short arc, keeping her hands, his wrist, and the bottle impact legible.

During seconds eight to ten, she releases him and pivots into a fast kick to another attacker's torso, sending him stumbling backward into the sofa. Track laterally with her rotation; keep the planted foot and recoil readable.

During seconds ten to twelve, the final attacker grabs her shoulder. She secures his arm, steps across his stance, lowers her hips, and throws him over her hip onto the floor. The camera retreats one step to contain the complete throw without cutting. Each attacker approaches from an established nearby position rather than appearing suddenly.

During seconds twelve to fifteen, the fight ends. She steadies her stance, breathing hard, then raises her head and takes one step toward the lens. The camera smoothly closes the remaining distance from a medium view to a tight facial close-up. End on her cold, defiant gaze, with smoke and the CRT glow behind her.

NO CUTS, no edits, no transitions, no hidden cuts, no montage, no inserted close-ups, no angle jumps, and no camera teleportation. No slow motion, speed ramps, bullet time, freeze frames, or slowed final reaction. Real-time gravity, falls, debris, and breathing throughout. Preserve continuous grips, anatomy, prop damage, and fallen attackers. No subtitles, readable logos, blood, or graphic wounds.

overall_soundscape
Synchronized impacts, rapid footsteps, strained breathing, wood splintering, glass breaking, liquid splashing, tiles clattering, and male exertion cries without intelligible dialogue. After the last landing, action sounds decay naturally. The final close-up emphasizes her heavy breathing and CRT static hiss.

non_diegetic_music
Low tense drone and pounding percussion during the fight. Cut the music at 00:12.000; this is an audio change only, with the uninterrupted camera take continuing.
